Effective Date: May 20, 2 013 Article 13.0 Signs Bridgewater Township Zoning Ordinance Page 13 - 1 ARTICLE 13.0 SIGNS Section 13.01 Purpose. The primary function of signage, as it relates to this Ordinance, is to identify a particular use or business occupying a lot or building in the Township. The Township further finds that reasonable use of signage promotes commerce in the Township. However, a proliferation of signs would unduly distract or endanger motorists and pedestrians; cause the deterioration of business or residential areas; obstruct vision; negatively impact property values; and reduce the effectiveness of private and public signage. A changeable copy area or electronic message board shall be allowed as part of a permitted building - mounte d sign or ground sign, subject to the following: 1. The permitted changeable copy area or electronic message board shall not exceed fifty percent (50%) of the total sign area. 2. The changeable copy area or electronic message board shall be limited to no more than two (2) revolutions or changes in the display per minute.
